Package com.microservices.warehouse.storages.controllers

Class PolicyController

java.lang.Object
com.microservices.warehouse.storages.controllers.PolicyController
@RestController @RequestMapping("api/v1/storage/policy") public class PolicyController extends Object
This controller handles HTTP requests related to policies for storage items. It interacts with the PolicyServiceManagement to manage policies and their associated documents.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Pouria Ghafarbeigi
